title: .NET Developer - Remote

title: Analista de Meio Ambiente Sr (Industrial Madeiras)
description:
No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras.
As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose branqueada em Inocência (MS).
Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC (Forest Stewardship Council) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.
Quer fazer parte do nosso time? Então, se inscreva em nossa oportunidade.
Todas as nossas oportunidades são destinadas para pessoas com ou sem deficiência.
Principais atividades:
Participar no processo de adequação de riscos ambientais especialmente no que se refere à gestão de resíduos sólidos, emissão de efluentes líquidos e gasosos, análises de solo e água subterrânea, dentre outros, a fim de mantê-los dentro dos padrões legais;
Acompanhar o controle das licenças e/ou autorizações ambientais, bem como, o desenvolvimento dos monitoramentos de medições, visando o atendimento da legislação pertinente e de inspeções e auditorias por órgãos credenciados e certificadores;
Controlar e avaliar os resultados de emissões gasosas, bem como, acompanhar o desenvolvimento de projetos que busquem melhorias e/ou otimização de custos em face que questões ambientais das unidades;
Participar de reuniões com autoridades e órgãos ambientais (Prefeitos, Secretários, FEPAM) nos assuntos referentes ao Meio Ambiente;
Planejar e elaborar controle de custos de destinação ou reciclagem de resíduos sólidos, em todas as fases do processo produtivo;
Fazer gestão e monitorar as ações relacionadas dos impactos das comunidades adjacentes às operações das unidades referente as questões ambientais;
Analisar e acompanhar os custos da área ambiental, elaborando a previsão de custos anuais e budget, bem como, acompanhando eventuais novas licitações de contratações;
Viabilizar a implementação e manutenção dos sistemas de gestão integrada definidos pela Empresa, promovendo sua divulgação, bem como, estabelecer ações que promovam a melhoria contínua e manutenção das rotinas necessárias de meio ambiente;
Apoiar na manutenção da certificação FSC Cadeira de Custódia (multi-site), mantendo os procedimentos documentados e comunicados para todos os sites participantes, bem como capacitar partes interessadas, planejando e executando auditorias internas e externas e assegurando o devido controle dos créditos.
Requisitos:
Sólida experiência em Gestão Ambiental Industrial;
Formação Superior em Engenharia Ambiental, Química, Biologia, ou áreas correlatas;
Domínio de legislação ambiental, licenciamento e contato com a FEPAM;
Experiência com gestão de resíduos industriais;
Excel avançado;
Habilidade com sistemas de gestão ambiental;
Desejável vivência com FSC - Cadeia de custódia e Especialização em meio ambiente.

title: Corretor Online / Executivo De Investimentos Imobiliários
description:
Job Description – Corretor Online / Executivo de Investimentos Imobiliários
Departamento: Comercial – Operação Online
Modelo: 100% Online / Híbrido (conforme política da House)
Nível: Executivo Comercial
Regime: PJ
Sobre a vaga
Buscamos um(a) Corretor(a) Online com perfil de Executivo(a) de Investimentos Imobiliários, especializado(a) em atendimento consultivo a investidores e com experiência em operações estruturadas via SCP (Sociedade em Conta de Participação).
O profissional será responsável por conduzir leads qualificados, apresentar oportunidades de investimento, orientar sobre retorno financeiro e garantir um processo de fechamento ágil, técnico e de alto nível.
A operação é digital, dinâmica, orientada à performance e focada em produtos compactos com forte demanda por investidores.
Responsabilidades
- Realizar atendimento consultivo a leads qualificados (inbound e outbound), com foco em investidores.
- Conduzir prospecção ativa de clientes alinhados ao perfil de investimento imobiliário.
- Apresentar oportunidades de investimento, estudos de retorno e viabilidades (yield, cap rate, ROI, valorização, projeções de locação short/long stay).
- Explicar de maneira clara o funcionamento da estrutura de SCP, seus benefícios, riscos e etapas operacionais.
- Acompanhar o cliente ao longo de toda a jornada, desde o primeiro contato até o fechamento.
- Elaborar apresentações comerciais e enviar materiais de suporte ao investidor.
- Registrar todas as interações no CRM, garantindo histórico detalhado e pipeline atualizado.
- Monitorar indicadores de performance (taxa de conversão, tempo de resposta, volume de atendimentos e prospecções).
- Manter-se atualizado(a) sobre mercado imobiliário, lançamentos, tendências e produtos de investimento.
- Atuar em conjunto com marketing, inteligência comercial e coordenação de vendas online para otimizar a operação.
- Cumprir metas comerciais, prazos e objetivos de produtividade.
Requisitos
- Experiência comprovada como corretor online, consultor comercial ou executivo focado em investimentos imobiliários.
- Vivência com operações estruturadas via SCP.
- CRECI ativo.
- Conhecimento de métricas financeiras relacionadas a investimento imobiliário (yield, cap rate, ROI, valorização).
- Experiência com CRM e rotina de atendimento digital.
- Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita, clareza técnica e forte capacidade de argumentação.
- Disciplina, organização e habilidade para gerenciar múltiplos leads simultaneamente.
Diferenciais
- Experiência em imobiliárias, consultorias, incorporadoras ou operações com carteira ativa de investidores.
- Atuação prévia com produtos compactos voltados ao público investidor.
- Certificações em finanças, investimentos, análise de dados ou mercado imobiliário.
- Carteira própria de investidores ou network ativo no segmento.
Perfil desejado
- Postura executiva e linguagem consultiva.
- Alta velocidade de resposta e capacidade de conduzir vários atendimentos ao mesmo tempo.
- Perfil analítico, com raciocínio financeiro apurado.
- Persistência, foco em resultados e forte habilidade de fechamento.
- Capacidade de simplificar modelos de investimento e transmitir segurança ao cliente.
- Motivação, disciplina e ambição para crescer dentro da operação.
Remuneração (PJ)
- Ajuda de custo nos 3 primeiros meses.
- Comissão por resultado de vendas.
- Bonificações por metas e desempenho.

title: MYP Design Teacher
description:
St. Nicholas
is looking for an experienced Design Teacher to join our Secondary section, starting in late July 2026. We invite suitably qualified candidates to apply, to support our students' learning journey in this exciting field.
Main responsibilities within the role:
To plan and deliver dynamic and student-centred lessons where the design cycle is an integral component.
To collaborate with the Design Technology department and wider teaching body, planning disciplinary and interdisciplinary units and lessons for grades 6-10.
To contribute to the development of an MYP Design Thinking programme and implement this methodology and other innovative practices to foster interdisciplinary understanding.
To be part of a growing department where teachers value sharing ideas, resources, and experiences.
To contribute to the Extra-Curricular Activities (ECA) programme and PSHE curriculum in a way that reflects your experience and interests.
To assist in curriculum development, ensuring it aligns with the school's inquiry-based philosophy and values.
To comply with and support the school's safeguarding practices, including e-Safety and child protection policies.
Required Skills and Attributes:
A relevant degree in Design (Graphic, Product or Digital), Architecture, Arts, Engineering, Education, or a related field.
Experience teaching Design or related subjects.
Strong knowledge of and experience with Design, Maker Spaces and DIY culture, as well as classroom pedagogy.
A commitment to inquiry-based learning and alignment with the school's vision and mission.
Ability to work collaboratively in a dynamic and stimulating international environment.
Desirable: experience with the IB MYP programme.
We offer:
Brazilian CLT contract with competitive salary, 13th salary, and severance fund contributions.
Comprehensive medical and dental plans.
Life insurance.
Breakfast and lunch at our school cafeteria.
Free tuition for up to two children.

title: Vice President of Sales - LATAM
description:
About GTT
GTT is a leading networking and security as a service provider for multinational organizations, simply and securely connecting people and machines to data and applications – anywhere in the world. We serve thousands of organizations, bringing together the right people, partners and technology to reduce the burden on IT teams and solve the most pressing networking and security challenges. Built on our top-ranked global Tier 1 network, GTT Envision is a single global technology platform to connect, orchestrate, virtualize and automate enterprise networks, enabling customers with consumable solutions to achieve business missions and meet ongoing demand when, where and how needed. Our portfolio includes SASE, SD-WAN, security, internet, voice and other connectivity options, complemented by a suite of professional services and exceptional sales and support teams in local markets around the globe. We partner with our customers to deliver Greater Technology Together.
Role Summary
The
VP, Sales - LATAM
drives
strategic market expansion
for GTT by developing and nurturing high-value, long-term relationships with key
Carrier, Wholesale, and Strategic Alliance partners
across the Latin American region. This role focuses on
ecosystem development
, identifying and securing new business models, and creating sustainable revenue channels through partnerships, rather than direct transactional sales. The Manager will be responsible for defining and executing the strategic plan to significantly increase GTT's market presence and network reach in LATAM.
Job Scope and Stakeholder Engagement
This role serves as a strategic bridge between GTT's offerings and the LATAM carrier market.
External Focus: Primary interaction is with executive and strategic planning teams at Target Carrier Partners, Global Data Center Providers, and potential Channel Partners to establish commercial, network, and technology alliances.
Internal Collaboration: Works closely with Product, Strategy, Finance, and Legal to define partnership terms and new commercial models. Acts as the voice of the LATAM market to inform Sales Engineering and Network Planning on necessary infrastructure investments.
Duties And Responsibilities
This role's success is measured by
strategic outcomes
and
long-term pipeline growth
, not immediate sales quota achievement.
Market Strategy & Penetration: Develop and execute a comprehensive LATAM Carrier Business Development plan, identifying white-space opportunities, competitive threats, and potential strategic partners to secure GTT's long-term competitive advantage.
Partnership Identification and Structuring: Proactively identify, qualify, and negotiate strategic agreements with major LATAM carriers (e.g., IXPs, Mobile Operators, Regional Tier 1/2 Carriers) to expand GTT's network footprint and service portfolio in the region.
Ecosystem Development: Cultivate a robust network of strategic channel and alliance partners to drive scalable, indirect distribution of GTT services.
Long-Term Pipeline Generation: Establish a pipeline focused on multi-year revenue potential stemming from new partnerships, joint ventures, and wholesale capacity swaps, ensuring sustainable growth.
Cultural and Business Acumen: Leverage deep regional knowledge and fluency in local business practices to effectively structure and manage relationships across diverse LATAM territories.
Reporting: Track and report on market penetration, new partnership launches, pipeline value of strategic deals, and the successful commercialization of new routes/services.
Required Experience/Qualifications
15+ years of experience in a Business Development, Partnership Management, or Strategic Alliance role within the global telecommunications/technology sector focusing on the LATAM carrier market.
Demonstrated Success in Ecosystem Building: A proven track record of successfully identifying, negotiating, and launching complex, non-standard commercial agreements (e.g., wholesale capacity swaps, joint GTM strategies, network peering).
Deep Regional Carrier Knowledge: Thorough understanding of the competitive landscape, regulatory environment, key contacts, and market trends across major LATAM countries.
Strategic & Financial Acumen: Knowledge of business concepts and financial modeling needed to assess partnership viability, structure favorable deals, and articulate the long-term return on investment (ROI).
Exceptional Communication & Negotiation: Superior ability to influence, communicate, and negotiate with executive-level stakeholders both internally and with external carrier partners.
Bilingual Proficiency: Fluency in Spanish and English is essential. Portuguese is a significant advantage, to effectively navigate business and cultural nuances in the region.
Networking and Relationship Capital: Existing strong relationships and a robust network within the executive and planning ranks of LATAM carrier accounts.
Ambition and Strategic Thinking: A proactive mindset focused on identifying and securing next-generation opportunities and expanding GTT's strategic positioning, not just fulfilling immediate demand.
Core Competencies
Business Acumen: Knowledge of business concepts, tools, and processes that are needed for making sound decisions in the context of the company's business; ability to apply this knowledge appropriately to diverse situations.
Effective Communications: Understanding of effective communication concepts, tools and techniques; ability to effectively transmit, receive, and accurately interpret ideas, information, and needs through the application of appropriate communication behaviors.
Negotiating: Knowledge of successful negotiation concepts and techniques; ability to negotiate successfully across the organization and with external vendors and clients in a constructive and collaborative manner.
Problem Solving: Knowledge of approaches, tools, techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem solving appropriately to diverse situations.
Networking: Understanding of the business value of creating mutually beneficial relationships with individuals outside of incumbent's own organization and ability to generate productive relationships with internal and external partners that improve access to resources and expertise.
Channel Sales: Knowledge of various channel sales strategies and solutions used to execute and fulfil a sales plan; ability to sell a hospitality organization's brand, products, and services through multiple and diverse avenues
Sales Proposals and Presentations: Knowledge of sales processes, tools, and techniques; ability to prepare and present formal recommendations for how the organization can meet the customer's needs.
Value Selling: Knowledge of the principles and practices for selling products, technology and services; ability to provide overall product/service 'value' and to differentiate support offerings that address clearly understood customer needs.
Universal Competencies
Continuous Improvement: Knowledge of transformation initiatives to drive fundamental changes, enhance responsiveness and efficiency to core business practices. Ability to drive cultural changes from best effort to results oriented.
Customer First (Customer Facing) : Knowledge of internal customer interactions, creating a culture of accountability, collaboration, and partnership. Ability to build an environment supporting internal customer value creation at every level.
Operational Excellence: Understanding the system-driven processes for consistency and scalability. Ability to re-focus processes and systems from integration activity to maximizing a positive customer impact and anticipating future trends.
EEO statement
GTT provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or genetics. In addition to federal law requirements, GTT complies with applicable state and local laws governing non-discrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.
GTT expressly prohibits any form of workplace harassment based on race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, or veteran status. Improper interference with the ability of GTT's employees to perform their job duties may result in discipline up to and including discharge.

Atuará de forma estratégica com as equipes comercial, planejamento, pré-impressão e produção, garantindo precisão nas estimativas, competitividade comercial e aderência às práticas e padrões operacionais da Viena.
Trata-se de uma posição presencial, de tempo integral, integrada ao time administrativo e comercial.

1. Análise e Construção de Orçamentos:
Elaborar orçamentos completos para livros, revistas, catálogos e materiais gráficos diversos.
Avaliar especificações técnicas (formatos, papéis, tiragens, acabamentos, encadernações e enobrecimentos).

Interpretar projetos enviados por clientes e traduzi-los em estruturas de custo.
Sugerir alternativas técnicas quando necessário para viabilizar prazos, custos ou qualidade.
Trabalhar alinhado com o PCP na validação de tempos, viabilidades e ocupação de máquinas.

Estimar tempos de produção, consumo de materiais e recursos necessários para cada etapa.
Participar da análise de viabilidade técnica e econômica de novos produtos, edições ou reimpressões.
Prever riscos e gargalos operacionais, propondo ajustes nos projetos.

Registrar e organizar orçamentos, históricos, revisões e resultados.
Alimentar indicadores internos de acerto orçamentário, conversão comercial e desempenho de custos.
Manter comunicação clara e objetiva com todas as áreas envolvidas.

Desejável conhecimento em softwares de orçamento gráfico. Noções de processos gráficos: pré-impressão, impressão offset/digital, acabamento, encadernação e logística.

Atenção aos detalhes e precisão. Capacidade analítica e pensamento crítico. Boa comunicação e trabalho colaborativo. Proatividade para solução de problemas e otimização de processos. Organização, disciplina e foco em resultados.

Vivência com fluxos de produção integrados e métricas de desempenho (KPIs).

title: Business Development Executive in Global Running Company - part-time with room to grow into full tim
description:
Hi... My name is Lena, and I am the founder of Go! Running Tours. This is not your usual job post. Instead of writing a fast-paced, bullet-pointed post with the words
driven
,
team player
,
high performer
, etc., I thought I would give it a go at simply writing the good, the bad, and the ugly about being a Business Development Executive with Go! Running Tours.
Maybe no one will reply. Maybe many will. I just need one really good one!
So let's start.
Our new Business Development Executive will be responsible for our hotel market in the US, Asia and South America. It is an area that we have not focused on in the past, but we have had ad hoc partnerships with various hotels and in various forms, and the time has come to truly focus and succeed in this market. I am looking for a Business Developer who is ready to fully own and grow this market for us. It is a market with huge potential and with great interest in our running tours, and hotels we are currently working with include Mandarin, Hilton, and Marriott.
You should be someone who gets super motivated by the fact that there is no straightforward playbook, but instead a lot of building blocks we need to put together to make the perfect Tetris game. When we have this, the world is your oyster, because what works in one hotel will likely be a success in another, and hotel managers talk. And here comes the true superpower of what you are selling. While there are many local running tour providers in each city, Go! Running Tours is the only global player. So when the global hotel chains start eyeing your success with a few of their hotels, you'll be able to enter into a global partnership. And that is really what we are aiming for!
Our new colleague should believe in email outreach. It is our main channel of business generation, and while we don't do stone-cold emailing, we have had success with lukewarm and hot emailing in other markets in the past. You will be responsible for the campaigns and everything that goes with it in terms of crafting messages, building contact lists, and data work. I personally love spreadsheet work and get a kick out of using data extra smart, and if you enjoy that as well, you will thoroughly enjoy this part of the role.
It is very important for me that you have the drive and passion to always reach higher. I am not looking for someone to simply do a routine job and be content when we start closing business. I want someone who is continuously energised by doing more, making progress, and growing and scaling. You should be constantly looking for new and better ways of doing things, testing initiatives, and learning new tech/solutions. We are counting on you to make this a global success (the first of its kind)! Drive and diligence are superpowers in this role!
But it is not all rosy. It can be a challenge for hotels to prioritise the implementation of Go! Running Tours into their services. It is frustrating when we are just about to sign a contract and then our contact moves jobs . Or when you dream of marketing spending millions on LinkedIn ads for the leads to simply land in your inbox but know it's not in our budget. That is why you also need to have grit, perseverance, and an optimistic mindset in this role, because you will succeed. You've got this
Our running tour service is both the most amazing product to sell and also somewhat difficult. Speak to a hotel manager who is a runner, and you'll be breezing through your presentation and the solution is implemented before you know it. Speak to a hotel manager who does not value wellbeing, and it takes a little more convincing. When it's a breeze, we are here with high fives. When it's harder, we brainstorm together with marketing and before they know it, even the nay-sayers are lacing up in their dri-fit!
You will be working directly with me in the role. I love my job, and every day I am utterly grateful that I work in a company with a concept that "makes sense" to me and with colleagues who are skilled, helpful, and positive. Some people may find me difficult to work with, as I am impatient, I focus radically on progress, and I dislike sloppiness (with a passion). Most people, I believe (or at least hope), find me also kind, fun, optimistic, and understanding (admittedly still very little understanding for sloppiness ;-)). Before applying please read this paragraph again, and only progress if this type of colleague and work environment would motivate you. It is important
We work remotely and have only 2 to 3 hours of internal meetings a week. All other time is reserved for client meetings, deep work, and basically getting things done. There is always time for a quick call and we are all on Slack, so you are not left alone in any way. We are just on the other side of the world
The salary is not one that will secure you a Ferrari or a holiday to Mauritius (at least not to begin with). It is a salary that should be comfortable and is based on reduced working hours, so you can have a fun and fulfilling life besides work. The money should not be the main motivation for you. Running, bridging cultures, and being part of a fun, fast-moving and positive company should.
The contract details are as follows:
USD 1200 + commission
30 hrs a week
Managed via Upwork
Oh, and hey... if you're considering this role as an add-on to an already existing full-time job, then hold your horses . I don't believe in my colleagues working 60+ hours a week, and it simply doesn't align with our company values. We want you to have the energy, focus, and headspace to do great work and enjoy life outside of it.
Last but not least, I am looking for someone who wears the "company shirt". This role should not be a left-hand job to simply earn money (to be honest, it would be a waste of an amazing job). This should be a role you are excited about, a product/service you think is fun and exciting to present to clients, and Go! Running Tours should be a company you enjoy representing and are eager to contribute to the overall success.
The most important traits to bring to the role are being a fast mover, a super collaborator, and having a sharp focus on closing a partnership. Answer emails straight away, answer Slack messages, follow up, follow up again, close the deal, and work with the hotels to ensure our services are implemented.
That's it, I think. I have probably left out loads of super important things, but at least this gives you some idea.
If you feel this role could be for you, then please write to me via

with a short spiel on why you feel you're right for the role and why you would like to work at Go! Running Tours (no AI please, we want to know the real you, not the ChatGPT version ).
Thanks for reading this far,
Lena

title: Senior AMLO
description:
Job Summary:
We are seeking a Senior AMLO to oversee the company's global AML framework, with primary responsibility for Brazil. The role covers regulatory obligations under BCB, COAF, CVM, and frameworks for electronic money issuers, payment institutions, and related sectors. You will serve as the main regulatory contact and designated MLRO for Brazil.
Key Responsibilities:
Lead the AML/CTF programme for Brazil, ensuring compliance with local laws and regulations (BCB, COAF, CVM, PIX, EMI/payment frameworks).
Act as the official MLRO for Brazilian operations and support regulatory expectations in other jurisdictions as needed.
Develop and maintain AML/CTF policies, KYC/CDD/EDD standards, and ongoing monitoring frameworks tailored to Brazilian requirements (CPF, CNPJ, beneficial ownership rules).
Implement governance aligned with BCB/COAF/CVM supervisory standards.
Conduct AML risk assessments and manage monitoring systems for transaction surveillance, sanctions/PEP screening, and detection of local typologies (e.g., PIX fraud).
Ensure timely COAF reporting and all mandatory filings for payment institutions.
Maintain proper audit trails and records under Brazilian retention standards.
Serve as the primary contact for BCB, COAF, and CVM for AML-related matters.
Deliver AML/CTF training covering Brazilian typologies, COAF red flags, and sector-specific risks.
Ensure compliance with LGPD and manage cross-border data transfers lawfully.
Qualifications:
Bachelor's degree in Law, Finance, Business, or related field; Master's preferred.
10+ years of AML/CTF experience with deep knowledge of Brazilian AML laws and regulatory frameworks.
Proven experience in AML leadership within payment institutions, EMI, fintech, or regulated financial environments operating across multiple jurisdictions.
Strong understanding of Brazilian PEP rules, ownership verification, PIX risk patterns, and reporting systems (SISCOAF, BCB platforms).
Excellent communication skills and experience working directly with Brazilian regulators.
Vision & Mission:
OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain's "killer app," with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.
Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

Job Purpose
The Autonomous Haulage System (AHS) is a comprehensive fleet management system for mines. The autonomous trucks are centrally controlled through a wireless network that integrates on-board vehicle controllers, high precision global positioning, and obstacle avoidance systems. The AHS Product Development team is responsible for building innovative solutions to unique and challenging autonomous operation problems. Working with our partners around the world, you will help design and support the next generation of mine optimization technologies and build the future platforms that will drive the changes in the mining industry for generations.
As a Senior Software Engineer – Autonomous Haulage System (AHS), you will engage with experienced cross-disciplinary team members to conceive and design innovative automation products. You will work closely with product management, hardware engineering, and operations teams. You must be responsive, flexible, and able to succeed in an open and collaborative peer environment.
Key job responsibilities
They will lead the design, development, monitoring, and enhancement of services our team provides for Komatsu customers. This includes Autonomous Haulage System services like machine coordination, equipment management, navigation planning, collision detection and safeguard management.
They will work closely with the Product Management team and engage directly with customers to understand customer needs and clarify product requirements.
They will have a deep knowledge of software design patterns, scalable cloud architectures, and cloud design best practices.
They have a good understanding of engineering trade-offs and make appropriate decisions on when to build new software, extend existing software, or integrate with software or systems provided by others.
They will generate clear and thorough analysis and design documentation and help improve the team's existing documentation.
They will have experience leading the translation of product requirements into a comprehensive system design, composed of logical, maintainable, extensible, scalable, and loosely coupled component services, and definition of the appropriate interfaces between these components.
They will understand and have experience with implementing security and data privacy best practices.
They will have experience developing automated tests at the unit, interface, contract and system level.
They will understand how to effectively monitor the systems they build and understand operational excellence best practices.
Be able to occasionally travel internationally.
Basic Qualifications
Experience building complex software systems that have been successfully delivered to customers
5+ years of programming experience, with strong Java coding skills
2+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team
Advanced English (written and verbal) for global team collaboration.
Preferred Qualifications
5+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
Experience in event-driven microservices and REST API's
Experience taking a leading role in building complex software systems that have been successfully delivered
Ability to take a project from scoping requirements to production operations
Demonstrated ability to mentor other software developers to maintain architectural vision and software quality
Experience in continuous integration and delivery, with testing automation
Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent.

title: Junior founding engineer
description:
The mission
Every year, over a million people move to the US on work visas. They're smart, ambitious, and excited—and then they land and realize the US is no longer made for newcomers.
It's overwhelming. The information is scattered across government websites, Reddit threads, and outdated blog posts. Every situation is slightly different, and one wrong step can cost weeks.
SettleKit fixes this.
We're building an app that guides immigrants through US settlement step-by-step and use AI to automate it.
We're early-stage and have multi-year runway. We need a salaried Founding Engineer to help us build this.
The role
You'll be our primary full-time engineer, working directly with me (Max, co-founder). We're a small team—you'll have real ownership from day one:
Building features end-to-end.
Our app is React on the frontend, Node.js/Express on the backend, PostgreSQL via (currently) Supabase.
Working on our AI research pipeline.
We use LLMs to generate workflow content from source documents
Thinking, not just executing
What's next for SettleKit and You
Right now, the app is in closed beta. Here's where we're heading:
AI-powered actions.
We want to go beyond telling users what to do. Think: AI that helps fill out government forms, generates document checklists, or drafts emails to employers...
Mobile app.
Vs.
today's webapp
Broader coverage
What we're looking for
1. Must have:
Experience with graph-based, tree, or conditional logic systems—our core product is a decision graph that adapts to each user's situation
2+ years building with React and Node.js (or similar full-stack experience)
Comfortable with TypeScript and SQL
You've shipped real products
Strong communication in English—we work async-first
Based in Latin America (Brazil, Argentina, Mexico, Colombia, or similar)—we're focused on LATAM for timezone overlap with NYC and the strong engineering talent in the region
2. Nice to have:
Experience with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Gemini, Claude)
Mobile development experience (React Native or native iOS/Android)
You've seen immigration complexity firsthand, or know people who have
3. What matters more than credentials:
You figure things out
You write clean code
You're excited about the mission
Why this role
Founding team.
You'll work directly with the founder. Your code ships to real users immediately
Build something that matters.
Immigration is broken. Help doctors, scientists, engineers, ... settle fast in the US so they can focus on their life and work
Learn by building production AI systems.
You'll get hands-on experience building real LLM-powered products
(Almost) no AI slop.
The product has so far been developed by human engineers, supported by Cursor/Claude
Compensation:
Full-time salaried position, above market rate depending on experience.

Overview
We are seeking an experienced

to join the Tax & Regulations team of a global independent support provider. This fully remote role focuses on

The analyst will act as the first point of contact for new legal and regulatory changes and work closely with Business Analysts and ERP/GTS specialists. Client interaction is minimal; the role is primarily research-oriented.
Key Responsibilities
Regulatory Research & Analysis
Monitor and maintain up-to-date awareness of legislative and regulatory changes in assigned countries using government websites, agencies, third-party sources, and in-country experts.
Track global trade compliance regulations, including
customs duties, export controls, sanctions, tariff updates
, and other relevant requirements across jurisdictions (U.S., Canada, LATAM, etc.).
Interpret, analyze, and document new or amended legislation in an internal repository with high accuracy and clarity.
Prepare comparative analyses of regulatory changes when required.
Ensure research and documentation meet
ISO process standards
.
SAP GTS Alignment
Research and provide insights relevant to SAP GTS (v11 or similar), supporting product specialists on topics such as:
Export Control & Licensing
Import Control & Market Access
Sanctions & Restricted Party Compliance
Customs & Tariff Management
Trade Agreements & Origin Management
Regulatory Reporting & Declarations
Product & Classification Compliance
Collaboration & Documentation
Deliver clear summaries and detailed regulatory insights needed by ERP and product specialists to implement system changes for clients.
Collaborate with Business Analysts and fellow researchers to validate findings and maintain consistency.
Support research expansion into
Indirect Tax
topics (VAT, GST, country-specific filing requirements) where applicable.
Must-Have Qualifications
Bilingual:
English + one LATAM language (Spanish or Portuguese)
.
5+ years
of professional experience in tax, global trade, or international regulatory research.
Working knowledge of
SAP GTS
or similar trade compliance systems.
Familiarity with international trade laws and frameworks (EAR, ITAR, EU Dual Use, WCO, etc.).
Strong research, analytical, and documentation skills with excellent attention to detail.
Nice-to-Have Skills
Ability to work independently, manage priorities, and handle multiple tasks under pressure.
Strong internet-based research capabilities and proficiency in business applications (Microsoft Office, Google tools, SharePoint, etc.).
Experience compiling complex regulatory information into clear, actionable summaries.
Technical understanding of SAP ERP tax/accounting workflows (advantageous, not mandatory).
Familiarity with tools like Excel, PDF generation, ABBYY FineReader, Deepl, Inoreader, Beyond Compare (training provided).
Self-starter with strong initiative, resourcefulness, and team-oriented mindset.
Additional background in
finance or tax
is a plus.
Why Join Us?
Work remotely while contributing to high-impact global compliance research.
Collaborate with a diverse international team of trade and tax experts.
Play a key role in helping global clients stay compliant with rapidly evolving regulations.

Como se candidatar:

O termo Conforme + Dominante vem do teste comportamental DISC , que classifica o comportamento das pessoas em quatro perfis principais:

  • D – Dominância
  • I – Influência
  • S – Estabilidade
  • C – Conformidade

No caso, “Conforme + Dominante ” significa que a pessoa tem predominância nas características de Conformidade (C) , mas também apresenta traços de Dominância (D) .

Isso gera um perfil que normalmente é:

Conforme (C) – Característica principal

  • Extremamente organizada
  • Segue processos e padrões
  • Atenta a detalhes
  • Gosta de fazer certo da primeira vez
  • Preocupada com qualidade e precisão

Dominante (D) – Característica secundária

  • Decidida e assertiva
  • Focada em resultados
  • Não tem medo de assumir responsabilidades
  • Capaz de tomar decisões rápidas
  • Sabe cobrar e manter prazos

title: Corretor De Imóveis
description:
Resumo do Cargo

O Corretor de Imóveis parceiro da Apolar Jardim Botânico é um profissional dinâmico e proativo, responsável pela comercialização de imóveis prontos (usados) e lançamentos em Curitiba e Região Metropolitana.

Como ter sucesso no cargo: O sucesso nesta função é impulsionado pela capacidade de entender e antecipar as necessidades dos clientes, oferecendo soluções imobiliárias que geram valor. Isso inclui uma gestão eficiente de leads de diversas fontes, um uso exemplar das ferramentas tecnológicas, e uma participação ativa na angariação de novos imóveis para a carteira. Profissionais que se destacam são aqueles que cultivam relações de confiança, dominam as técnicas de negociação, e mantêm-se atualizados sobre o mercado imobiliário e as condições de financiamento. A colaboração com a equipe e o alinhamento com os objetivos da franquia são diferenciais para alcançar o sucesso.

Responsabilidades
  • Angariar Imóveis: Identificar e angariar ativamente imóveis (usados e lançamentos) na região de Curitiba e Região Metropolitana, expandindo o portfólio da franquia e visando atingir a meta de 100 imóveis em carteira.
  • Gestão de Leads: Gerenciar e qualificar leads provenientes de diversas fontes (portais de anúncio, anúncios patrocinados, portal da Rede Apolar, LAIS), realizando o primeiro contato, acompanhamento e nutrição para convertê-los em clientes qualificados.
  • Uso de CRM: Determinar e desenvolver requisitos de usuários para sistemas em produção (Apolar Sales), garantindo o preenchimento completo e organizado de todas as informações de clientes, imóveis e interações, otimizando o fluxo de trabalho.
  • Atendimento ao Cliente: Realizar atendimento consultivo e personalizado, compreendendo a real necessidade do cliente, apresentando as opções de imóveis mais adequadas e conduzindo visitas de forma eficaz.
  • Negociação e Fechamento: Conduzir processos de negociação de compra e venda, elaboração de propostas e acompanhamento de contratos, garantindo a segurança e transparência em todas as etapas da transação.
  • Colaboração com a Equipe: Colaborar ativamente com a equipe de corretores, gerência e franqueados parceiros, compartilhando informações de mercado, estratégias e melhores práticas para otimização dos resultados coletivos.
  • Avaliação de Imóveis: Colaborar no processo de avaliação de imóveis quando solicitado, utilizando o conhecimento de mercado e, se certificado, o registro no CNAI.
  • Conhecimento de Mercado: Manter-se atualizado/a sobre as tendências do mercado imobiliário de Curitiba, novas legislações, condições de financiamento e o perfil de cada bairro para oferecer um serviço consultivo de excelência.


Qualificações
  • Formação: Ensino Médio completo. Curso superior, é um diferencial, mas não obrigatório.
  • Registro Profissional: Possuir registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Corretores de Imóveis (CRECI).
  • Experiência: Experiência prévia comprovada na comercialização de imóveis, com preferência para atuação em imóveis usados e/ou lançamentos.
  • Competências de Comunicação: Excelentes competências de comunicação oral e escrita, com clareza, persuasão e habilidade para se comunicar por telefone e WhatsApp.
  • Habilidade Tecnológica: Familiaridade e disposição para utilizar ferramentas de CRM (Apolar Sales) e outras tecnologias para gestão de leads, acompanhamento de processos e organização de informações.
  • Proatividade e Resiliência: Capacidade de agir com proatividade na busca por resultados e na angariação de imóveis, além de resiliência para lidar com objeções e desafios do mercado.
  • Orientação para o Cliente: Forte orientação para o cliente, com foco em entender suas necessidades, construir relacionamentos de confiança e proporcionar uma experiência de compra positiva.
  • Organização: Boa capacidade de organização e atenção aos detalhes para manter registros precisos e acompanhar múltiplos processos simultaneamente.
  • Infraestrutura: Possuir carro, notebook, acesso à internet fora do escritório e celular para desempenho das atividades.

description:

- Active Directory/ Radius/802.1x/ MFA authentication.

.

- Firewalls Paloalto and network security administration.

- Palo Alto Panorama and large number of firewall visibility and administration.

- Setup, configuration, integration, design, zero trust. Rules optimization, IP Policy and documentation

- Hardening, standard setup to prod preparation, capacity planning, high availability and failover

- Virtual and appliances devices, cloud and on prem, backup & Restore.

- VPN IPsec and Client to site implementation

- Integration with other security team members from threat intel, SOC

- Experience for EndUser support in record, diagnose and solve problems in the scope of microcomputing, hardware, operating systems, telephony, videoconferencing, web conferencing, audio conferencing and related areas, including performing any corrective maintenance on ICT equipment;

- Experience to clarify doubts and guide users regarding the use, availability, installation and configuration of software, applications, information systems (both those in the market and those developed internally), equipment, standards and procedures on the technological environment of the Customer and its use

- Test functionalities of new equipment, components or peripherals, and prepare configuration and user guides or manuals;

- Act in the execution of activities of the asset management process in Customer locations where there are no asset technicians allocated, at times when the Asset Management service is not available or whenever required by supervision.

- Understand cybersecurity attacks, mitigation methods.

The network Associate is responsible for the LAN, WAN, WLAN or SDWAN Network. On LANs, WANs, WLANs, SDWANs, it is responsible for addressing, switches, routers, WiFi related devices, AD, DNS, NPM, Firewalls, CDN's, Balancers, NFV. title: Supervisor De Laboratório
description:
Vaga: Supervisor(a) de Laboratório – Laboratório Lafiqui

Local : Santo Antônio de Posse – SP

Sobre a empresa:

O Laboratório Lafiqui é referência em soluções inovadoras no setor de análises laboratoriais, oferecendo serviços de qualidade e precisão para diversos segmentos.


Estamos em busca de um(a) Supervisor(a) de Laboratório com experiência em análises físico-químicas e bromatológicas para liderar nosso time técnico e garantir a excelência dos processos e resultados laboratoriais.


Principais responsabilidades:

  • Liderar e desenvolver a equipe técnica , promovendo capacitação e garantindo o cumprimento das metas e padrões de qualidade;
  • Orientar e treinar novos colaboradores conforme as políticas da empresa;
  • Planejar e distribuir as tarefas diárias, garantindo a execução precisa e reprodutível das análises;
  • Supervisionar as análises físico-químicas e bromatológicas e aprovar resultados técnicos;
  • Assegurar o uso correto e eficiente dos equipamentos analíticos (Dumas, Kjeldahl, Soxhlet, analisador de fibra, pHmetro, espectrofotômetro UV-Vis, entre outros);
  • Implementar e monitorar o sistema de gestão da qualidade (ISO/IEC 17025:2017), tratando não conformidades e propondo ações corretivas;
  • Gerir oestoque de reagentes, consumíveis e materiais de laboratório, bem como acompanhar as necessidades de manutenção dos equipamentos;
  • Garantir o cumprimento das normas de segurança e representar o laboratório nas atividades relacionadas à segurança do local;
  • Elaborar relatórios técnicos, interpretar resultados e fornecer suporte técnico às equipes de serviços técnicos e comercial;
  • Promover a integração entre o laboratório e outras áreas da empresa (qualidade, formulação, produção e comercial).


Requisitos:

  • Formação superior em Química, Farmácia, Engenharia Química ou áreas afins ;
  • Experiência em laboratório físico-químico na área de nutrição animal;
  • Vivência com análises bromatológicas e liberação de laudos ;
  • Experiência em supervisão de pessoas e gestão de equipes;
  • Conhecimento prático em equipamentos como: analisador de nitrogênio (Dumas e Kjeldahl), Soxhlet, analisador de fibra bruta, pHmetro e espectrofotômetro UV-Vis;
  • Familiaridade com a norma ABNT NBR ISO/IEC 17025:2017 .


Perfil desejado:

  • Boa capacidade de relacionamento;
  • Organização, proatividade e senso crítico;
  • Habilidade paraadministrar o tempo e priorizar atividades.


Benefícios:


  • Plano de saúde Unimed;
  • Plano odontológico Uniodonto;
  • PLR (Participação nos Lucros e Resultados);
  • Convênio Farmácia;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Vale-Refeição;
  • Vale-Alimentação;
  • Transporte fretado para Jaguariúna, Campinas e Santo Antônio de Posse.

description:
Head of Product Design (UI/UX, AI-Forward) - Contractor


Downstream · Open to employees in Argentina, Bolivia, Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Ecuador, Guyana, Paraguay, Peru, Suriname, Uruguay, Venezuela


About Downstream


Downstream is transforming the construction industry by building a marketplace for equipment rentals, portable toilets, and roll-off dumpsters. We are scaling fast. Our vision: bring price transparency, automation, and intelligence into one of the most manual, underserved verticals in the economy.


We’re inspired by clean design and modern architecture—and we’re pushing forward with AI-native product thinking, not bolting it on later.


The Role


We’re hiring a Head of Product Design (UI/UX) who is obsessed with creating intuitive, elegant, and impactful user experiences. You’ve shipped something before—whether at a startup that scaled, a product that users loved, or a platform that redefined a workflow. You know the pain of turning complex problems into simple, usable solutions, and you want another shot at shaping an industry from 0 → 1.


At Downstream, you’ll work directly with our CEO, CTO, and Product team to:

  • Define and own the design vision for our marketplace, supplier tools, and customer experience.
  • Lead end-to-end design for web and mobile, including UX flows, UI systems, and visual identity.
  • Architect AI-native product experiences that feel intuitive, not artificial—helping users trust automation and agents in critical workflows.
  • Collaborate with engineers and product managers to ship fast: prototype, test, iterate, and refine.
  • Build and scale our design system so we can move quickly without sacrificing quality.


Responsibilities

  • Drive the product design strategy across customer, supplier, and internal platforms.
  • Build and maintain UI/UX standards that reflect simplicity, trust, and efficiency.
  • Design AI-native experiences—where agentic systems interact seamlessly with users, data, and decisions.
  • Conduct user research and usability testing with construction industry stakeholders.
  • Mentor and grow a design team as we scale.


What We’re Looking For

  • Battle-tested designer: You’ve shipped real products (startup, marketplace, SaaS, or similar).
  • AI-forward mindset: You don’t just add AI—you design around it, making it feel natural and empowering.
  • Builder’s DNA: Comfortable with ambiguity, speed, and iteration. You’ve felt the pain of building in the real world and still want more.
  • Technical & design skills:
  • UI/UX design (Figma, Sketch, or equivalent)
  • Strong UX research and prototyping chops
  • Design systems and component libraries
  • Understanding of modern frontend frameworks (bonus: Flutter, React)
  • Experience designing for AI interactions (chat, agents, workflows)
  • Startup mentality: Hands-on, resourceful, willing to go beyond your job title.
  • Industry experience: Construction tech or marketplaces a huge plus—someone who can empathize with our users.


Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience in marketplaces, logistics, SaaS, or fintech.
  • Familiarity with B2B workflows and procurement tools.
  • Contributions to open-source design systems or AI products.


Why Downstream

  • Early-stage, high-growth startup with real traction.
  • Work with a small, sharp, and ambitious product + engineering team.
  • Opportunity to shape AI-native product experiences in an industry that hasn’t seen this level of innovation before.
  • Competitive salary + equity

title: Game Operations Analyst/Senior Analyst
description:
About Garena:

Established in 2009 and headquartered in Singapore, Garena is a leading online games developer and publisher with a global footprint across more than 130 markets.

Garena provides global users access to popular and engaging mobile and PC online games that it develops, curates, and localizes. It champions games as a social and entertainment platform on which its communities can engage and interact.

In addition, Garena is a leading esports organizer. It hosts esports events around the world that range from grassroots local tournaments to some of the most viewed professional esports competitions globally. The Free Fire World Series 2021 Singapore, which was watched by 5.4 million concurrent viewers at its peak, holds the record for the highest concurrent viewership of any esports match in history.



Main Responsibility

Support the strategy and performance of digital game operations, ensuring an excellent player experience while contributing to product evolution and monetization.



Job Description

  • Assist in analyzing player behavior and game performance to suggest improvements in retention, engagement, and monetization.
  • Collaborate on planning in-game events, update cycles, and monetization strategies.
  • Monitor real-time data to identify optimization opportunities.
  • Work alongside product, marketing, and support teams to ensure smooth operations and timely content delivery.
  • Create reports and dashboards tracking key metrics.
  • Research industry benchmarks to support strategic decisions.
  • Present insights and recommendations to internal teams, turning data into actionable strategies across departments.



Our Ideal Candidate

You are a driven and resilient professional who thrives in fast-paced environments and complex challenges. You bring:

  • Passion: A deep enthusiasm for gaming and a fearless curiosity to explore new ideas and territories.
  • Aptitude: A natural ability to quickly learn and master new skills, tools, and methodologies.
  • Drive: Unwavering commitment to overcoming obstacles and pushing boundaries to achieve your goals.



Requirements

  • Bachelor's/Master's degree completed or expected between December 2022 and December 2025 in Engineering, Business, Marketing, Digital Games or other fields
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English
  • Able to work in São Paulo, SP (Hybrid: 3 days in-office, 2 days remote)
  • Able to work in a full-time position (8 hours per day)
  • Passionate about games
  • Knowledge in Microsoft Office and/or Google Workspace (Word/Docs, Excel/Sheets, PowerPoint/Slides)



Why Join Us

Join a dynamic team where you will be directly involved in high-impact strategic projects that shape the future of our games and brand. Benefit from personalized mentorship and continuous learning opportunities through close collaboration with our experienced management team. Your creativity and insights will truly matter in an environment that prioritizes your professional growth.

title: Cabotage Coordinator
description:
Cabotage Coordinator

Job Title: Cabotage Coordinator

Location: São Paulo, Brazil

Terms: Full Time. On site.

Compensation: Commensurate with experience, the individual’s, and the team’s performance.

Company:

Sky Fusion Global Supply Chain focus on global dry bulk shipping and Industrial Projects Logistics. Headquartered in Singapore, we have settled filiales in China, Morocco, South Africa, Australia, Brazil, USA, Germany, and continues to be a globally expanding group.


Our Core Business:

  • Global Dry Bulk Freight
  • Industrial Projects Logistics & Renewable Energy Supply Chain Innovation


For more information, you may check our website：


Role

Sky Fusion is seeking the right candidate to fill a key role, the new Cabotage Coordinator. The primary focus of this role is the coordination of bids for Brazilian Flag impelled cargo opportunities. These are cargoes that will move within the Brazilian territory.

The coordinator will be tasked with evaluating and pursuing both commercial and operational cargoes for carriage on the Company’s Brazil Flag vessels. The scope of these cargo bids may often require extension of the scope to include use of multimodal forms of conveyance.

Candidates are encouraged to think outside of the box. There are always new challenges on the horizon and ways to improve, even in a business as old as shipping.

This position will challenge the coordinator to come up with creative solutions by matching multiple fleet schedules and modes of transportation with various bids. This role will require constant interaction and communication with the Client’s team to ensure the successful execution of projects.


Responsibilities & Duties

a. Identification and pursuit of chartering opportunities for wind projects.

b. Voyage calculations and pricing of both near‐term and long‐term project cargoes.

c. Analysis of intermodal bids (commercial).

d. Administration of quoting system. Emphasis on visibility within team and timely communications with

customers.

e. Project monitoring

f. Tracking Wind Cargo Flows (Historic & Projected)


Requirements & Skills

a. Ability to multi‐task

b. Understanding of terms and conditions for contracts of carriage and carriage of breakbulk cargoes under Brazilian Cabotage legistlation.

c. Strong verbal and written communication skills

d. Attention to detail.

e. Minimum of bachelor’s degree (preferably in a Maritime Business Administration or Transportation).

f. Minimum three (3) years of experience in the Fluvial / Caoastal cabotage transportation industry is preferred but candidates with les experience will still receive consideration.


Personal Characteristics

Ambitious | Enthusiastic | Team player

Ensino médio completo;

Curso de NR10.

Capacidade resolutiva;

Comunicar-se de forma inclusiva e eficaz diante um público multicultural e amplamente conectado;

Proatividade em executar as manutenções.

title: Fund Manager
description:
Fund Operations Manager (AMIF)

Location: Sao Paulo, Brazil - On site

Company: Amicorp Fund Services


Are you an experienced fund professional ready to take the lead in managing complex fund structures, driving operational excellence, and fostering lasting client relationships? Join Amicorp Fund Services , a trusted global provider of fund administration and corporate services, and play a pivotal role in expanding our fund operations footprint.


About the Role

As Fund Operations Manager , you will ensure Amicorp meets all contractual, regulatory, and statutory obligations while actively supporting commercial growth. You’ll oversee the setup and administration of multiple investment funds, manage a dedicated team, and act as a key liaison between clients, investors, and internal departments.

This role blends technical fund expertise , leadership , and a commercial mindset — ideal for someone passionate about both operations and strategic growth.


Key Responsibilities

Client & Deal Management

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for a portfolio of fund administration clients, fostering long-term, trust-based relationships.
  • Advise on optimal fund structures, legal and regulatory frameworks, and ongoing process improvements.
  • Oversee the drafting and review of commercial, fiscal, and legal documentation.
  • Support fund launches, restructures, and liquidations, ensuring seamless execution and compliance.
  • Attend client and internal meetings to provide technical and operational insights.

Sales & Business Growth

  • Contribute to the commercial growth of Amicorp Fund Services by identifying opportunities and closing deals aligned with business targets.
  • Develop and execute an ambitious sales plan, focusing on expanding relationships with existing clients and attracting new investors.
  • Oversee smooth onboarding and transition management for new clients, ensuring a best-in-class experience.

Operational Excellence & Compliance

  • Collaborate with global accounting teams (India/Mauritius) to deliver accurate and timely fund administration services.
  • Review NAV packages, financial statements, and investor reports to ensure accuracy.
  • Monitor KYC/AML checks, fund compliance, and audit readiness.
  • Maintain comprehensive client records and ensure adherence to all reporting and regulatory requirements.

Team Leadership

  • Lead and mentor the Fund Operations team, ensuring high performance, accountability, and professional growth.
  • Oversee training, performance management, and productivity tracking.
  • Promote standardized procedures, process optimization, and continuous improvement across operations.


What We’re Looking For

  • Bachelor’s degree (minimum) with 15+ years of experience in the investment fund industry.
  • Strong professional network within family offices, investment advisers, foreign investors, and the venture capital community.
  • Proven experience managing teams and fund operations in a fast-paced environment.
  • Expertise in fund accounting, NAV calculations, capital calls, audit processes, and tax fund structures.
  • Strong understanding of IFRS / US GAAP and both UCITS and Alternative Investment Funds (AIFs) .
  • Excellent client-facing, communication, and leadership skills.
  • Commercially driven, proactive, and detail-oriented mindset.
  • Experience with PFX Paxus is an advantage.
  • CGA / CGE certification required.


Why Join Amicorp?

At Amicorp, we believe in empowering our people to lead with purpose, innovate fearlessly, and deliver excellence. You’ll work with a global network of experts, gain exposure to diverse jurisdictions, and be part of a company that values integrity, collaboration, and professional growth.

Join us to make a lasting impact in a dynamic and truly international fund services environment.


✨ Ready to elevate your career and lead with impact?

Apply now and become part of Amicorp’s global success sto

title: Engenheiro De Controle
description:
About Woodgrove


We are a leading provider of energy efficient, innovative equipment, instrumentation, and process control systems to the global mining industry. With companies in Brazil, Chile, Mexico, and South Africa, Woodgrove has built a reputation based on quality, performance, and safety. The company is entrepreneurial, dynamic and our team are driven to succeed. We are looking for like-minded individuals that want to be part of a transformational business.


Role Summary

This role is for a position within the Advanced Process Control (APC) department. The APC department works with mine sites around the world (both remotely and on site) to deploy and integrate optimization solutions for the benefit of clients and industry. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys travelling and has an analytical mind.


All resumes must be in english.


Responsibilities

  • Development, deployment, and integration of Advanced Regulatory Control applications
  • Support deployment and integration of Expert Systems
  • Analyze and troubleshoot control system issues and provide solutions to improve system performance and reliability.
  • Experience commissioning and tuning of control systems.
  • Produce technical documentation (e.G., reports, manuals, specifications, drawings)
  • Conduct data analyses.
  • Verification and validation of software through inspection, simulation, and testing
  • Work with cross-functional teams to develop and implement control systems for new projects.
  • Perform regular reviews and upgrades on existing control systems to ensure optimal performance.
  • Ensure compliance with safety regulations and industry standards.


Qualifications/Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Control and Automation Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field
  • English: intermediate, conversation level
  • Extensive experience in a control engineering project environment
  • Knowledge and axperience with multiple control systems, including PLCs, SCADA systems, and DCS systems (ABB, DeltaV, Siemens, Rockwell, Schneider, Honeywell, etc.)
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to troubleshoot control systems.
  • Proficiency with programming languages such as Ladder Logic, Function Block Diagram, and Structured text
  • Strong written, communication and interpersonal skills
  • Familiarity with industry standards and regulations related to control systems.

Somos a Greystar, um conceito de apartamentos de aluguel totalmente equipados, com um serviço de gerenciamento profissional que está estabelecendo o padrão no mercado. Nosso principal objetivo? É oferecer um estilo de vida exclusivo focado em nossos residentes vivendo uma experiência única.


Somos uma empresa que tem as pessoas no centro de tudo o que fazemos e trabalhamos com base em nossos pilares e valores;

É por isso que nossos valores promovem um ambiente de diversidade, igualdade e inclusão, estabelecendo uma base e uma mentalidade pela qual orientamos os membros da equipe, nossos residentes, comunidades e parceiros. Somos uma empresa comprometida em criar um ótimo local de trabalho para todos e reforçamos isso com nossas iniciativas de diversidade, igualdade e inclusão.

  • Momento de carreira: Profissional com experiência prática em vendas e atendimento. Alguém em fase de crescimento na carreira, com energia e ambição para colaborar em um ambiente dinâmico.
  • Formação e experiências anteriores: Preferencialmente com passagem por startups, ou empresas de tecnologia ligadas ao setor imobiliário principalmente de curta estadia, para entender mais do nosso dinamismo. Experiência com inside sales , atendimento digital e foco em fechamento são diferenciais.
  • Habilidades técnicas: Conhecimento sólido em ferramentas de CRM, domínio do pacote Office (com foco em Excel) e boa fluência em Outlook. É essencial ter excelente escrita – clara, profissional e persuasiva, tanto para e-mails quanto para WhatsApp, além de boa comunicação presencial.

Funções:

  • Gestão Comercial: Gerir o ciclo completo de vida do cliente, desde a prospecção, acompanhamento e fechamento, visando a máxima ocupação das unidades (seguindo os padrões de qualidade da empresa).

title: Sales Consultant
description:
About Us

Established 20 years ago, Phi Partners is a global technology services consultancy based out of London with an annualized turnover of £50m.


We operate exclusively within capital markets, in the front office, pricing and risk space, covering both business and technology services. With six lines of business, four international hubs and five international delivery centres, Phi has become a leading global financial markets IT services provider within our niche domains. We have over 500 consultants supporting more than 80 financial institutions around the world.


Our international sales team run out of Wrotham Business Park in London where we have over 30 sales consultants covering the broad range of business lines, clients and geographies. This team includes junior sales personnel who focus primarily on candidate research and recruitment whilst they are being trained to become client-facing sales consultants and eventually account managers. We are now expanding out Sales & Research team to include a team in our São Paulo office!


Phi offers our clients a comprehensive range of services including staff augmentation, advisory, project and managed services. These deals range from £100,000 to £20,000,000 in size, creating huge revenue and earnings opportunities.


Role and Career Opportunities

Phi has an ongoing commitment to growth in terms of client acquisition, geographical reach, and evolution of our lines of business and service catalogue. To support our ambitions, we take on four cohorts of junior sales consultants each year, in January, April, July, and October. Each consultant is trained the “Phi way”.


We are looking for talent who are either fresh out of university or in the early stages of their careers. Subject to meeting reasonable competency and performance targets, you can expect regular opportunities for advancement throughout your journey:


  • In the first 6 months you will be in our London Office being trained by our leadership team.
  • Initially, you will focus on candidate research and recruitment. After six months, you will be allocated to a line of business, allowing you to become a specialist recruiter within that field. Training that is specific to the line of business will allow you to master your ability to converse confidently with client and internal specialists.
  • After a period of between 12-18 months, you can expect to begin your move into client-facing sales. You will be allocated a small number of clients specific to your line of business, beginning your journey with client research, leading into full client engagement if the client is approved as a target.
  • Once you have closed deals with clients (bringing master services agreements between the client and Phi), you will begin to generate P&L. Subject to competency and revenue targets, you will complete your move into sales. We expect this phase to take between 18-24 months, and you will be supported on your journey by more senior sales leads, a deal architecture / pre-sales team, and the subject-matter-experts from within the delivery teams.
  • As a fully-fledged sales consultant, you will be part of a smaller group of 10, that are some of the best in the world. You will manage your client portfolio and may be given an expanded scope of clients giving you the room to really become a true success. Depending on results, you may be allocated one or two strategic key accounts, with the greatest potential for growth. These accounts are global, and relevant for multiple lines of business. They will bring a large portfolio, driving significant P&L and earnings.


Our most successful salespeople will make Partner at Phi, giving access to stock in the company that is granted annually based on a transparent assessment of contribution. Within the sales team we have three partners today, all of whom came through the graduate program, and we except two more to get promoted in 2025. The sky is the limit at Phi for the most ambitions and driven!


What we are looking for

Commitment and drive

We are looking for highly motivated individuals with a strong desire to succeed, and who are prepared to do “whatever it takes”. We are looking for problem solvers who have the ability to “find a way” to solve any challenge;
people who won’t give up when the going gets tough! To become successful, it will take a long time to develop the required skills to be independent and to operate autonomously. So, we are looking for people who are truly committed and driven. These are all skills that you will have had life-long, applied and improved over many years. We will be looking to understand what drives you at a fundamental level, as this is what you will rely on to succeed.


Communication and charisma

Our sales consultants must be great communicators: people who have natural confidence with person-to-person communication, from over-the-phone interactions to directing meetings with senior stakeholders. You will need to be charismatic and confident. An ability to develop meaningful and relationships built on respect and trust is critical.


Team spirit

At Phi we have maintained a “small company” mindset and feel, with an excellent team spirit – we work together, we socialize together, we support each other. Our appreciation for the wider Phi community makes us stronger than the sum of our parts. We are looking for people who will naturally be at home as part of a strong team – who can understand our values, contribute to the wider Phi community, share knowledge, and put the team before themselves. We will be looking for evidence of this, academically, professionally, or outside (such as sport).


Life at Phi

Phi is an established business but feels like a start-up, specially being part of our brand-new team in Brazil. Your base will be in São Paulo, but as you develop into client-facing sales, you will spend time out of the office and will have opportunities for regular international travel.


Our family mentality means that even the most junior at Phi has access to the senior leadership team. We are approachable. You will be on first name terms with the CRO and CEO. Beyond the sales team, you will work within a wider community across pre-sales and delivery, specific to your clients and your line-of-business.


Our company thrives in having a diverse and international staff and this is especially true in our London office, where the Sales & Research team is located. Our sales consultants come from all parts of the world and there is a vibrant and youthful atmosphere. The atmosphere is dynamic and busy (punctual starts and hard work are inevitable), but always friendly. We socialize regularly outside office hours. Many of the senior team members at Phi have known each other for decades, and people who are the right fit for Phi can expect to build friendships that will last a lifetime. The goal is to build a similar environment in our new operation in Brazil!


Training and Reward

You can expect initial and ongoing training, in a well-designed, competency-based framework with a comprehensive and growing learning and development library. You can expect to be carefully performance-managed using our proprietary tools, ensuring that your contributions are fairly measured and that you are supported in your drive to succeed in any areas that need developing.


We offer competitive salaries and the best commission structure in the market. We have a simple and straightforward commission model that rewards you for what you generate. With no caps, your earning potential is unlimited.

title: Finance Manager (Brazil)
description:
The Finance Manager will oversee all financial, accounting, and tax functions for the Brazilian entity, ensuring compliance with local statutory requirements, tax regulations, and corporate reporting standards. The role encompasses daily accounting operations, month-end and year-end closings, and statutory audits, while providing management with financial analysis, budgeting support, and strategic guidance. The ideal candidate will possess strong technical accounting expertise, exceptional attention to detail, and the ability to excel in a fast-paced start-up environment.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Responsible for the maintenance of accurate financial reports and accounting records in line with corporate guidelines, corporate timelines and local statutory requirements.
  • Manage the full spectrum of the accounting functions, including accounts payables, accounts receivables, balance sheet schedules, general ledger maintenance, and cash flow management.
  • Manage closing processes and preparation of accurate and timely financial reports and analysis of financial information.
  • Ensure compliance with all federal, state, and municipal tax obligations.
  • Manage tax incentives including PPB (Processo Produtivo Básico) and tax optimization opportunities ensuring compliance with Brazilian tax laws.
  • Coordinate and liaise with external parties (e.G. banks, external auditors, tax agents, corporate secretarial agents, local tax and government authorities) to ensure smooth operations.
  • Collaborate across departments in preparing and managing the OPEX budgets.
  • Identify and implement process improvements in internal accounting and financial operations efficiency.
  • Partner with business units to provide finance-related advice.
  • Coordinate with headquarters to align local reporting with group consolidation requirements.


Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting.
  • Minimum 7 years of experience in finance and tax management, including 3+ years in an international setting.
  • Knowledge of Direct and Indirect tax.
  • Advanced analytical skills and high attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to interact with all levels of the organization.
  • Ability to work independently, manage pressure, and meet tight deadlines.
  • Proficiency in English.
  • Prior experience in accounting firms is an added advantage.
